title: Painting a "regular person" character without fantasy crutches
excerpt: The hardest brief I take — a character in jeans and a hoodie, no armour, no staff, no fantasy props. How face, posture, hands, and one telling detail carry the painting.
seo_title: Realistic Character Commission: Modern Portrait, No Crutches
seo_description: How to commission a realistic modern character portrait without fantasy props — face, posture, hands, environment, and the single detail that makes the painting land.
